summary: A 100-foot Aermotor lookout in Kemper County, registered in 2022; the lower stair treads have been removed and the register says the MFC no longer uses the site.

facts.status_note: Last recorded in a site visit noted 7/3/22.

access.note: The register notes the treads are removed from the bottom two flights of the internal staircase. No source says whether the site is open to visitors.

events.note: Site visit noted as 7/3/22: treads removed from the bottom two flights of the internal staircase.
Registered July 10, 2022 as US 1667, MS 31, nominated by Jason Johns.
The register says the MFC no longer uses the site; the date of that change is not given.

evidence.supports: 100-foot Aermotor with a diagonal internal staircase
evidence.quote: 100ft Aermotor with a diagonal internal staircase

evidence.supports: treads removed from the bottom two flights
evidence.quote: Treads removed from the bottom two flights

evidence.supports: site no longer used by the Forestry Commission
evidence.quote: the site is no longer used by the MFC

notes_for_editor: Single source (NHLR) after two searches and a check of the Kemper County history page, which had nothing on the tower. The access level is left unknown: the removed treads suggest the stair cannot be climbed as it stands, but no source says whether the site is open or closed. The register does not give the date the MFC stopped using the site. The 100 ft height is converted to 30.5 m. A business listing for the MFC De Kalb office mentions Firetower Road; we did not confirm any link to this tower and did not use it.
